provenance.construction: One [[4,2,2]] distance-amplification step (Liang, Gu, Chen, Eisert, Wang, arXiv:2609.37231, Eqs. (14), (15); amplifier checks G_X = G_Z = the all-one row of length 4) applied to the board entry codes/126-24-11.json ([[126,24,11]] two-block code over C63; d_X = d_Z = 11 certified in certs/126-24-11.json), keeping all of its checks.X except the rows [43, 49, 51, 52, 54, 56, 57, 58, 59, 60, 61, 62] and all of its checks.Z except the rows [50, 51, 52, 54, 55, 56, 57, 58, 59, 60, 61, 62] (linearly independent, 51 and 51 rows). Qubits: central (q,a) -> 4q+a (q a base qubit, 0 <= a < 4); t_j -> 504+j for the j-th kept Z-check z_j; s_i -> 555+i for the i-th kept X-check c_i. X-checks: (c_i,a) = {4q+a : q in c_i} + {s_i} (i, then a), then (q) = {4q,...,4q+3} + {t_j : q in z_j} (q = 0..125); Z-checks: (z_j,a) = {4q+a : q in z_j} + {t_j}, then (q) = {4q,...,4q+3} + {s_i : q in c_i}. n = 4*126 + 51 + 51 = 606 = 5n - k of the base, k = 2*24 = 48, check weight 10.
provenance.notes: Distance: d_X = d_Z = 22 exactly: d_P = 2 d_P(base) for P = X, Z by Lemma 4 of arXiv:2609.37231 (proof in the coordinates of this entry: Proposition 4 of amplified-and-folded-codes/README.md, github.com/TimoKellerMath/quantum-error-correction @ c203901854da), and d_X = d_Z = 11 for the base is certified in certs/126-24-11.json (tropidist b03ec2d4077f, level solver). Witnesses: u (x) (e_0 + e_1) for the witnesses u of codes/126-24-11.json. Filed as upper_bound with these witnesses: the board earns the exact tier only through certs/, and its certifiers do not reach d = 22 at k = 48. The construction and the base are published; at board commit 8042f9da no CSS entry dominates or equals this code in (n, k, d, w), and no entry has its n and k unless named here; checked, not equivalent to an existing entry. The board entry 630-48-22 is the amplification of the same base with all 63 + 63 base rows, which this code shortens to n = 606 by leaving out dependent rows.
